sources.title: Phase retrieval by iterated projections
sources.author: Veit Elser
sources.scope: Sections 2 (Fourier/histogram definitions) and 8 (strange-attractor discussion); Figure 14 pixels inspected. Other proofs not fully reviewed.
sources.finding: Explicit earlier attractor portraits use a 32-component inconsistent Fourier/histogram problem and sections of four phase angles. They are not full three-coordinate spatial-circle portraits. No inequivalence theorem follows from this difference.

sources.title: A unified evaluation of iterative projection algorithms for phase retrieval
sources.author: S. Marchesini
sources.scope: Section III and equation 25; Figure 4/5/6 pixels on PDF page 7. Related projector definitions read; remaining sections not fully reviewed.
sources.finding: Figure 5 uses a union of two circles as one constraint and a line as the other. Its RAAR setting beta=0.75 tends near a local minimum. This is a distinct benchmark, not proof of attractor inequivalence.

sources.title: RRR origins
sources.author: Veit Elser
sources.scope: Eight-slide text inspected, especially slides 4 and 7; no claim to inspect every embedded image.
sources.finding: Explicit ADMM-to-RRR variable change at relaxation one and the RRR update are prior descriptions. RRR and RAAR relaxation parameters must not be conflated.

sources.title: Solving Problems with Projections, Chapter 5: Reflect-Reflect-Relax
sources.author: Veit Elser
sources.scope: Publisher summary, public contents and index only. Chapter body requires access and was not read.
sources.open_gap: Priority review of the global-behavior and RRR/ADMM sections remains necessary.

outcome: No exact match located in a bounded search; historical uniqueness and attractor-class inequivalence remain unresolved.
